_note: Input to tools/build-sets.mjs. Quiz sets, format neo-quiz-set/1, the contract
in quiz-site/llms.txt. Every item is generated from data/, so a set can never
carry a word, a kana or a line the corpus does not carry. A beats item's
explain line is the seed word's own when it has one, else its rule's line
from rules.json, else null; the generator writes no line of its own.
Item ids are derived from the corpus id of the record they came from, so a
re-run over the same corpus emits the same ids. quiz:answer carries that id
as itemId and Runcible stores it as evidence, so an id that moves between
runs orphans every attempt a person made on that item.
Each set is written twice, once under quiz-site/data/sets/ for the Quiz
library and once under books/japanese/sets/ for the Runcible chapter that
embeds it. Same generator, so they cannot drift; the build cmp's them.
The order kind expands to one set per song in data/songs/index.json. A song
gloss is the researcher's English; es is null unless glosses_es names a
Spanish line for that song and verse, because this file does not translate.
